---
title: "The Secular Case Against Gold"
date: "2005-12-02"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

With the gold price at 23 year highs, [Mahalanobis](http://mahalanobis.twoday.net/stories/1219099/ "Mahalanobis") reminds us of the secular case against gold.  The [Dow/gold ratio](http://www.321gold.com/editorials/russell/dow_gold.html "Dow/gold ratio") isn’t pretty either.  Funnily enough, gold bugs love this chart, believing it shows overvaluation in stocks!
